name: Long COVID
condition_granularity: Prevention after acute infection and treatment of established illness remain separate subscopes; fatigue, cognition, PEM and autonomic outcomes are not extra conditions.

name: Acute COVID-19
condition_granularity: Outpatient deterioration, hospitalized severe disease and prophylaxis have different PICO; never infer Long COVID treatment from acute effects.

name: Epithelial ovarian or fallopian-tube carcinoma
condition_granularity: One related disease family reflecting the observed question; split site, histology, platinum sensitivity, stage and maintenance versus active therapy within it. These are not five additional conditions.

name: Glioblastoma
condition_granularity: Do not count glioma, astrocytoma and GBM as synonyms without pathology; only exact GBM anchors qualify below.

name: Fibromyalgia
condition_granularity: Chronic pain is broader than fibromyalgia. DR025 is a shared multi-condition question, not an independently validated fibromyalgia demand estimate.

name: Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome
condition_granularity: Separate from Long COVID even when diagnoses overlap; do not count fatigue alone as this diagnosis. Shared DR025 signal is not additive.

name: Compulsive sexual behavior disorder
condition_granularity: Distinct behavioral disorder; not a synonym for persistent genital arousal or a general libido concern.

name: Persistent genital arousal disorder/genitopelvic dysesthesia
condition_granularity: Separate involuntary arousal/dysesthesia and associated pain endpoints from compulsive behavior; one overlapping diagnostic construct.

name: Treatment-resistant depression
condition_granularity: Do not count anhedonia as another condition; distinguish unipolar/bipolar diagnosis, prior treatment and augmentation. Generic depression evidence is indirect.

name: Periodontitis
condition_granularity: Keep inflammatory periodontal disease separate from caries, microbiome shifts and oral cancer; sirolimus demand does not establish doxycycline demand.

name: Crohn disease
condition_granularity: Computational-screen example linked to the observed modeling question; no Crohn-specific Reddit question established. Separate refractory colonic subgroup and clinical benefit.

name: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
condition_granularity: Broad cancer evidence-reading extension; do not combine with esophageal SCC or skin SCC. Stratify site and HPV status if sources report them.

name: Prostate cancer
condition_granularity: Owner-required itraconazole cancer lead. Separate localized, biochemical relapse and metastatic castration-resistant disease; no direct prostate-specific demand measured.

name: Non-small-cell lung cancer
condition_granularity: Lung cancer with unspecified histology is related context, not exact NSCLC evidence; SCLC is excluded from this node.

name: Breast cancer
condition_granularity: One condition entity with molecular subtype/stage strata; triple-negative disease is not counted as an extra condition.

name: Colorectal cancer
condition_granularity: Colon and rectal site-specific treatment retained as strata in one family; prevention and established-cancer therapy separate.

name: Pancreatic cancer
condition_granularity: Prioritize original clinical verification of textbook adjunctive itraconazole claims; do not merge neuroendocrine and ductal disease.

name: Melanoma
condition_granularity: Distinct from basal-cell and squamous skin carcinoma; unspecified skin-cancer evidence cannot fill this node.

name: Basal-cell carcinoma
condition_granularity: Itraconazole preface lead only; distinguish locally advanced disease and prevention, and keep melanoma separate.

name: Hepatocellular carcinoma
condition_granularity: Exact hepatocellular pathology required; liver metastases or generic liver cancer do not automatically qualify.

name: Multiple myeloma
condition_granularity: Separate from monoclonal gammopathy and lymphoma; line, combination and supportive role remain distinct.

name: Acute myeloid leukemia
condition_granularity: Distinct from CML and ALL; no umbrella leukemia node counted in addition. Preserve molecular subtype and induction/maintenance/residual-disease roles.

name: Chronic myeloid leukemia
condition_granularity: Biologically distinct chronic leukemia; residual disease plus TKI therapy is not interchangeable with untreated CML.

name: Parkinson disease
condition_granularity: Corpus-led metformin trial and minocycline futility example; no condition-specific Reddit demand in this discovery set.

name: Schizophrenia
condition_granularity: Clinical metformin cognition and computational candidates remain different evidence types; not generic psychosis or depression.

name: Alzheimer disease
condition_granularity: Minocycline negative clinical summary supports failure-literacy fetch; preclinical tau/amyloid models cannot establish patient benefit.

name: Multiple sclerosis
condition_granularity: Computational aspirin example plus minocycline null adjunctive trial; first demyelinating event, RRMS and progressive MS remain separate strata.

name: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
condition_granularity: Deliberate negative/harm calibration based on minocycline chapter; no direct ALS Reddit signal established.

name: Vitiligo
condition_granularity: Corpus-led adverse/negative statin calibration and rituximab small pilot; segmental status and light co-treatment must be retained.

name: Sarcopenia
condition_granularity: Clinical condition connected editorially to healthspan/exercise questions; longevity, ovarian aging and exercise performance are not diagnostic synonyms or separate counted conditions.
